title: Jawi dialect
description: Nearly extinct dialect of the Bardi language of Western Australia
extract: Jawi or Djawi or Djaui, is a nearly extinct dialect of the Bardi language of Western Australia, the traditional language of the Jawi people. There are no longer any known fluent speakers, but there may be some partial speakers.
